channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Trump claims El-Sayed is Muslim Brotherhood, El-Sayed denies
item.description: Donald Trump has claimed that El-Sayed is "100%" Muslim Brotherhood, a statement that El-Sayed has again denied. The Washington Post reported El-Sayed's repeated denials of ties to the organization. Forbes characterized Trump's claim as… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Election officials are debunking a persistent false claim circulating on social media that ballots marked by a poll worker will be disqualified. These posts falsely suggest that any ballot touched or marked by a poll worker will be… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump's Economy and Midterms: A Potential Drag for Republicans
item.description: The U.S. midterm elections may be negatively impacted by Donald Trump's economic policies, according to analysis from CNN. Forbes, meanwhile, is examining the potential for Trump to influence Iran's economy. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The Sports Ministry has initiated a review of its funding policies for National Sports Federations (NSFs) following the Asian Games. The ministry has stated that NSFs should not use funding as an excuse for performance and must deliver… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Activist claims potential detention ahead of 'Tiranga' march
item.description: Abhijeet Dipke stated he is prepared to go to jail and anticipates potential detention before a planned 'Tiranga' march. The march is scheduled to take place at Connaught Place. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: India Rejects China's Objection to Naming Ladakh Locations
item.description: India has rejected China's objection to the naming of 28 strategic locations in Ladakh. China had previously raised objections to India's decision to name these sites. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay conducted a roadshow and inaugurated the Periyar Knowledge Centre in Coimbatore. The events took place during his visit to the city. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: On Thursday the Defence Ministry signed contracts worth about ₹4,106 crore for two indigenous systems: the GSAT‑7C communication satellite for the Indian Air Force and the Varunastra heavyweight torpedo for the Navy, with the satellite… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 3.

item.description: A special session of Parliament is anticipated to take place this month, with the government reportedly considering it to pass the Women's Reservation Bill and the Delimitation Bill. The Centre may provide a one-week notice before the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Election Polling Described as Unpredictable and Chaotic
item.description: Coverage describes the current state of election polling as unpredictable and chaotic, likening it to the "Wild West" and "Monty Python." The reports focus on the volatile and unusual nature of the polling landscape. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: UK Business Secretary Kemi Badenoch stated that Scottish devolution is a "process and not a religion," suggesting its future is open to discussion. She challenged Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham to rule out a Scottish independence… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump's Russia Pivot Draws Criticism
item.description: Donald Trump's recent actions have been characterized as a "pivot to Putin," a move described by critics as "superpower suicide." This shift in focus has drawn significant negative attention and commentary. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Elon Musk has agreed to settle lawsuits concerning a 2024 election lottery. Musk founded America PAC, which supported Republican Donald Trump's 2024 presidential campaign. Separately, Musk has donated over $150 million to a Senate GOP… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: A political storm has erupted in Tamil Nadu over the purchase of electricity at a rate of Rs 35-37 per unit. Edappadi K. Palaniswami, leader of the opposition, has termed the purchase a "vettri mega scam". The issue has led to significant… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Opposition leaders have called for the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. P. Chidambaram criticized CEC Kumar over a "SIR U-Turn," stating he should be "surcharged." Akhilesh Yadav demanded CEC Gyanesh Kumar's removal… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Election Commission Begins Voter List Revision in 17 States
item.description: The Election Commission of India has initiated a special summary revision (SSR) of electoral rolls in 17 states and union territories. The process aims to update voter lists, with a set timetable for the revision. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Microsoft President Brad Smith has warned that restrictions on green cards could negatively impact the US technology sector. Smith stated that Microsoft hired over 9,000 US-born workers last year and that most of the company's green-card… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
